title: haumaniastrum semilignosum
intro: Haumaniastrum semilignosum, commonly known as the Chinese Thyme or Thymus, is a medicinal plant belonging to the family Lamiaceae. The health benefits of Haumaniastrum semilignosum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which can help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect cells from damage. Its therapeutic actions include being used to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as to aid in digestion and reduce menstrual pain. The bioactive constituents of Haumaniastrum semilignosum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
